name: Color Table Filtering
aliases: Rhoades et al. Color Table Filtering
definition: A method to filter procedural textures by filtering the 1D color table C rather than the noise function, returning the average color over a small interval.
summary: Color Table Filtering anti-aliases procedural textures by MIP-mapping the color table to average colors over a noise interval, distinguishing itself by operating on the color mapping rather than pre-sampled voxel data.
